app.alreadyRunning: AvellCC is already running (see the tray icon).
dash.freeMemoryHelp: Trims the memory of all running programs. Nothing is closed and no data is lost: the pages stay cached and come back instantly when a program needs them. Windows already does this on its own when RAM runs low, so the gain is mostly visual.
dash.cleanDiskHelp: Opens Windows Storage settings: cleanup recommendations, temporary files and Storage Sense. Windows shows the sizes and asks before deleting.
dash.cleanDiskFailed: Could not open Windows Disk Cleanup.
banner.noServiceSim: The simulation service is not running. Start it with: AvellCC.Service.exe --simulate
banner.noService: AvellCC service unavailable. Install it with tools\install.ps1 (as administrator) or check services.msc.
banner.vendor: {0} Stop the GCUBridge service (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, Rule 1). Fans are under firmware control.
banner.error: Fan control error: {0}. Fans returned to firmware control.
fans.help.firmware: The laptop's embedded controller runs the factory curve; AvellCC only reads and displays. It is conservative: about 30 % at idle and about 77 % at 84 °C, and it never reaches 100 % on its own. Works even with the AvellCC service stopped.
fans.help.curve: The AvellCC service reads the temperature every 2 s and sets the fan speed from the selected curve: hysteresis, smooth slow-down, 25 % minimum and 100 % in an emergency (CPU ≥ 92 °C / GPU ≥ 87 °C). It hands control back to the firmware if the service stops or fails, the laptop sleeps, or Avell Custom Control is running.
fans.help.apply: Nothing changes until you click Apply mode.
fans.name: Name
fans.shared: Fans together (highest of the CPU and GPU curves)
fans.rules: Rules: increasing temperatures, % never decreases, last point at or below 90 °C with at least 80 %. Effective minimum 25 % (fans never stop). Del removes the selected row.
fans.legend: vertical lines = current temperature · dot = current duty
fans.savedActive: It is the active curve, so it is already in effect.
fans.savedInactive: Use Apply mode to activate it.
fans.errHysteresis: Hysteresis must be a whole number.
kb.profilesHelp: Pick a profile to apply it. To create one, set up the lighting below, type a name here and click Save profile (saving an existing name replaces it).

settings.modeButtonHelp: With an AvellCC curve active, each press of the laptop's mode button switches to the next curve and shows a notice. Turn it off if the curve changes when you did not press it.
settings.startupHelp: The AvellCC service starts with Windows and controls the fans even with this window closed.
settings.languageHelp: To add a language, copy Languages\en.json to Languages\<code>.json (e.g. es.json) and translate the values.
